title: See your theory of change in chat with Claude
description: Describe your program and Claude draws the causal chain inline, inputs through impact, with every arrow clickable to show the assumption behind it.
prompt: I run a youth mentoring program. We pair high schoolers with adult mentors for weekly meetings over a year, and the goal is higher graduation rates. Show me our theory of change, and I want to be able to click the arrows between boxes to see what assumption each one is riding on. Where are the weak links?
prerequisites: Optional: formal logic model or grant narrative paragraph
notes: Uses custom visuals feature in chat.
